title: England and Wales lender Certificate of Title / Report on Title directory
disclaimer: Research index and routing guidance only, NOT approval to certify title or release funds. Matter-specific mortgage instructions override directory; each entry must be live-checked immediately before use. An LMS document listing does not prove electronic CoT submission. Not exhaustive of UK mortgage lenders or all products. Do not reuse lender-branded forms across group brands.

status_meanings.verified_submission: Official source confirms a concrete delivery route within stated product/representation scope; live transaction verification still required.
status_meanings.verified_conditional: Source confirms route only subject to case, product, representation or an independent update check.
status_meanings.verified_document_only: Official portal/website lists a lender-specific CoT or documents; how to submit has NOT been verified.
status_meanings.verified_directory_or_panel: Official source confirms lender has a document/panel presence, but no submission route confirmed.
status_meanings.lookup_only: Lender coverage for prompt routing only; no lender-specific COT/RoT process verified.

lenders.product_and_representation_scope: Barclays Business, not ordinary Barclays Bank UK residential
lenders.document_location: Barclays business solicitor instructions website > downloadable CoT (owner-occupied) or Report on Title (residential let/lease); transaction instruction letter

submission.instructions: Follow the precise Barclays BUSINESS instruction letter; website says printed, signed return no less than 7 days before completion, with online Report on Title/Collateral Portal alternatives if instructed. Do not apply this commercial route to Barclays Bank UK residential offer.

notice.notes: Website says no less than seven days but does not identify a business/calendar-day convention in the public snippet; confirm offer.

warnings: Use the lender-issued unamended form; report unsuitable wording separately in covering letter.
Do not confuse Certificate of Title with Report on Title.
